      :type: bool

.. py:function:: ensure_full_pipeline_require_stages(stages: list[str]) -> list[str]

   Ensure the upload gate includes stage-7 morphometrics for a complete bundle.


.. py:function:: parse_require_stages(spec: str) -> list[str]

   Parse ``--require-stages`` into canonical qvtpy stage ids.

   Always includes ``stage7`` (morphometrics) so uploaded ``qvtpy`` resources
   reflect the complete pipeline, not hemodynamics-only outputs.


.. py:function:: eicab_dir(output_root: pathlib.Path, subject: str) -> pathlib.Path

   Stage 1 (eICAB) output directory for *subject* under *output_root*.


.. py:function:: qvtpy_dir(output_root: pathlib.Path, subject: str) -> pathlib.Path

   qvtpy stage output root for *subject* under *output_root*.


.. py:function:: eicab_complete(output_root: pathlib.Path, subject: str) -> bool

   True if *subject*'s stage-1 eICAB output contains a segmentation.


.. py:function:: qvtpy_stage_complete(output_root: pathlib.Path, subject: str, stage_id: str) -> bool

   True if *subject*'s *stage_id* QC check reports it complete.


.. py:function:: qvtpy_all_required_complete(output_root: pathlib.Path, subject: str, required_stages: list[str]) -> tuple[bool, list[str]]

   (all complete?, list of incomplete stage ids) for *subject* over *required_stages*.


.. py:function:: upload_subject_to_xnat(subject: str, *, output_root: pathlib.Path, xnat_session: Any, project_id: str, required_stages: list[str], upload_eicab: bool = True, upload_qvtpy: bool = True, overwrite: bool = False, skip_existing: bool = True, dry_run: bool = False) -> UploadResult

   Upload eicab/qvtpy resources for one subject.
